```{=html}
<div class="mz-steps" data-steps aria-roledescription="guida a passi">
  <div class="mz-stage">
    <video class="mz-theme" muted playsinline loop preload="none" data-light="media/e1-light.mp4" data-dark="media/e1-dark.mp4" data-poster-light="media/e1-light.jpg" data-poster-dark="media/e1-dark.jpg"></video>
    <video class="mz-theme" muted playsinline loop preload="none" data-light="media/e2-light.mp4" data-dark="media/e2-dark.mp4" data-poster-light="media/e2-light.jpg" data-poster-dark="media/e2-dark.jpg"></video>
    <video class="mz-theme" muted playsinline loop preload="none" data-light="media/e3-light.mp4" data-dark="media/e3-dark.mp4" data-poster-light="media/e3-light.jpg" data-poster-dark="media/e3-dark.jpg"></video>
    <video class="mz-theme" muted playsinline loop preload="none" data-light="media/e4-light.mp4" data-dark="media/e4-dark.mp4" data-poster-light="media/e4-light.jpg" data-poster-dark="media/e4-dark.jpg"></video>
    <video class="mz-theme" muted playsinline loop preload="none" data-light="media/e5-light.mp4" data-dark="media/e5-dark.mp4" data-poster-light="media/e5-light.jpg" data-poster-dark="media/e5-dark.jpg"></video>
  </div>
  <div class="mz-body">
    <div class="mz-slide"><h3><span>1</span>Il riquadro</h3><p>Ogni tratto diventa un riquadro. Sopra scegli cosa mettere sugli assi x e y.</p></div>
    <div class="mz-slide"><h3><span>2</span>Retta a occhio</h3><p>Muovi le due maniglie finché la retta passa in mezzo ai punti, poi leggi la pendenza Δy/Δx. Alla fine il confronto con il computer.</p></div>
    <div class="mz-slide"><h3><span>3</span>Fit</h3><p>Scegli un modello (retta, parabola, sinusoide…). Il computer trova la curva migliore e ti dà la grandezza fisica con la sua incertezza.</p></div>
    <div class="mz-slide"><h3><span>4</span>Righello</h3><p>Sulle onde: metti le due linee su due creste e conta i periodi N tra le due. <span style="white-space:nowrap">T = Δt / N</span>, <span style="white-space:nowrap">f = 1 / T</span>.</p></div>
    <div class="mz-slide"><h3><span>5</span>Salva ed esporta</h3><p><b>＋ Salva</b> il risultato, spunta i riquadri, <b>Esporta in Excel</b>.</p></div>
  </div>

</div>
```

```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  // versione: letta dall'app stessa, così è sempre quella pubblicata
  fetch('app/version.json', { cache: 'no-cache' }).then((r) => r.json()).then((v) => {
    const h = document.querySelector('h1.title');
    if (h && !h.querySelector('.mz-ver')) { const s = document.createElement('span'); s.className = 'mz-ver'; s.textContent = `v${v.app}`; s.title = `Mosaicus ${v.app}, firmware ${v.firmware} (${v.date})`; h.append(s); }
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-mz-fw]').forEach((e) => (e.textContent = `v${v.firmware}`));
  }).catch(() => {});

  // tema del sito (chiaro/scuro): scelgo i video giusti e li cambio se il tema cambia
  const dark = () => document.body.classList.contains('quarto-dark');
  const setSrc = (v, force) => {
    const want = v.dataset[dark() ? 'dark' : 'light'];
    v.poster = v.dataset[dark() ? 'posterDark' : 'posterLight'] || '';
    if (v.dataset.loaded || force) {
      if (!v.currentSrc.endsWith(want)) { const play = !v.paused; v.src = want; v.dataset.loaded = '1'; if (play) v.play().catch(() => {}); }
    }
  };
  const all = () => document.querySelectorAll('video.mz-theme');
  all().forEach((v) => setSrc(v, v.autoplay));
  new MutationObserver(() => all().forEach((v) => setSrc(v, false))).observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });

  // guide a passi: frecce, pallini, scorrimento del dito, tastiera
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-steps]').forEach((box) => {
    const media = [...box.querySelector('.mz-stage').children];
    const slides = [...box.querySelectorAll('.mz-slide')];
    const dots = box.querySelector('.mz-dots');
    slides.forEach((_, i) => { const d = document.createElement('i'); d.title = `Passo ${i + 1}`; d.addEventListener('click', () => go(i)); dots.append(d); });
    let k = 0;
    const visible = () => box.offsetParent !== null;
    function go(i) {
      k = Math.max(0, Math.min(slides.length - 1, i));
      slides.forEach((s, j) => s.classList.toggle('on', j === k));
      media.forEach((m, j) => {
        m.classList.toggle('on', j === k);
        if (m.tagName !== 'VIDEO') return;
        if (j === k) { setSrc(m, true); m.currentTime = 0; if (visible()) m.play().catch(() => {}); }
        else if (j === k + 1) { m.preload = 'auto'; setSrc(m, true); m.pause(); }   // il prossimo si prepara intanto
        else m.pause();
      });
      [...dots.children].forEach((d, j) => d.classList.toggle('on', j === k));
      box.querySelector('[data-prev]').disabled = k === 0;
      box.querySelector('[data-next]').disabled = k === slides.length - 1;
    }
    box.querySelector('[data-prev]').addEventListener('click', () => go(k - 1));
    box.querySelector('[data-next]').addEventListener('click', () => go(k + 1));
    box.tabIndex = 0;
    box.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') go(k + 1); if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') go(k - 1); });
    let x0 = null;
    const stage = box.querySelector('.mz-stage');
    stage.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => (x0 = e.clientX));
    stage.addEventListener('pointerup', (e) => { if (x0 == null) return; const dx = e.clientX - x0; x0 = null; if (Math.abs(dx) > 40) go(k + (dx < 0 ? 1 : -1)); });
    go(0);
    // il video parte solo quando la guida è sullo schermo
    new IntersectionObserver((en) => en.forEach((x) => { const v = media[k]; if (v.tagName !== 'VIDEO') return; x.isIntersecting ? v.play().catch(() => {}) : v.pause(); }), { threshold: 0.4 }).observe(stage);
    box._go = go;
  });

  const dlg = document.getElementById('mzInstall');
  document.querySelector('[data-open-install]').addEventListener('click', () => { dlg.showModal ? dlg.showModal() : dlg.setAttribute('open', ''); dlg.querySelector('[data-steps]')._go(0); });
  dlg.querySelector('[data-close]').addEventListener('click', () => dlg.close());
  dlg.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === dlg) dlg.close(); });
})();
</script>
```
